## Prior-incident review assignment
Records of past incidents whose observations resemble this one are provided
below. They may or may not describe the same underlying fault.

{{PRECEDENTS}}

Use these records as hypotheses only — a past incident is never evidence
about the live one. Investigate this cluster independently: for any mechanism
suggested above, verify or falsify it against live evidence gathered in this
session, and diagnose whatever the live evidence best supports, whether or
not it matches the records.
